rootCause: The historical workflow was triggered, but its job-level condition excluded every job. Failure notifications were incorrectly interpreted as evidence of unavailable event dispatch or runner capacity.
contributingFactors: Historical workflow used broad pull_request triggers.
The workflow filename and notification text obscured that no job entered a runner.
The repository contains extensive historical workflow accumulation, increasing control-plane noise.

correctiveAction.behavior: The already registered workflow now creates one relay job for the canonical branch, explicitly skips non-exclusive commits, and opens runtime only for an authorized exclusive v8 request commit.
